goal: Let operators retain visibility into privately broadcast transactions after they finish or echo back
Prevents send history, peer acknowledgment times, and echo details from vanishing upon completion
reviewability: Ready for review with nothing known that would invalidate looking at the code now
agreement: Concept support because keeping completed transaction info helps operators monitor broadcasts (optout21)
Addressed issues where retry logic broke and subsequent peers overwrote echo details (frankomosh)
Open suggestion to add a test ensuring first-received peer data is not overwritten (frankomosh)
